title: Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
keyFacts: The risk of famine is growing in parts of Sudan already torn apart by war, as a severe El Niño drought makes life even harder in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, the UN-backed global hunger monitor warned on Monday.

title: UN aid operation underway in Nepal following fresh floods
keyFacts: The United Nations has rushed to assist Nepal following new flash floods in the central Gorkha district on Sunday that swept away homes and bridges just weeks after catastrophic flooding in the north.

title: Rise in poverty is ‘a wake-up call for the world’, UN development chief says
keyFacts: The number of people living in “multidimensional” poverty has risen for the first time in 15 years, reaching 1.2 billion, as families struggle to meet their basic needs.

title: Djibouti shipwreck: Death toll rises to 139 as 84 remain missing
keyFacts: At least 139 migrants have died after their boat capsized off Djibouti, with a further 84 people still missing, the UN migration agency (IOM) said on Sunday.

title: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza
keyFacts: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.

title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
keyFacts: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.
